### Introduction

JULES (Joint UK Land Environment Simulator) is a land surface model developed by the UK Met Office. The PEcAn package `PEcAn.JULES` provides integration with the PEcAn workflow system.

See the [JULES README](https://github.com/PecanProject/pecan/blob/develop/models/jules/README.md) for installation guidance and configuration details.

### Installation

```r
# Install from r-universe
options(repos = c(
  pecanproject = 'https://pecanproject.r-universe.dev',
  CRAN = 'https://cloud.r-project.org'))
install.packages('PEcAn.JULES')
```
